AssociateSourceServers.description_en: To migrate servers as a group, you must first associate the migration sources with that group
AssociateSourceServers.description_zh: 如果您需要通过工作组批量迁移服务器，需要先将迁移源关联到工作组

CreateCrossZoneMigrationJob.description_en: Server Migration Center (SMC) lets you migrate an Alibaba Cloud Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance to a different zone within the same region and change its instance type, including the vCPU and memory, within the same instance family. This feature helps you meet business requirements for instance migration and specification changes. Call this operation to create a cross-zone migration job
CreateCrossZoneMigrationJob.description_zh: SMC支持将阿里云云服务器ECS迁移到同地域的不同可用区，同时也支持在同规格族内更改实例规格（vCPU和内存），满足您迁移云服务器ECS和变配实例规格的业务需求。您可以通过此接口创建跨可用区任务

CreateReplicationJob.description_en: Creates a migration task for a migration source by calling CreateReplicationJob
CreateReplicationJob.description_zh: 调用CreateReplicationJob为迁移源创建一个迁移任务

CreateWorkgroup.description_en: Workgroups are used to manage the lifecycle of multiple migration tasks in batch server migration scenarios
CreateWorkgroup.description_zh: 工作组可以同时管理多个迁移任务的生命周期，适用于需要批量迁移服务器的场景

CutOverReplicationJob.description_en: Stops the periodic execution of a specified incremental migration job and completes the migration
CutOverReplicationJob.description_zh: 将指定的自动增量迁移任务停止周期执行，并完成迁移任务

DeleteReplicationJob.description_en: You can call DeleteReplicationJob to delete a migration job
DeleteReplicationJob.description_zh: 调用DeleteReplicationJob删除一个迁移任务

DeleteSourceServer.description_en: You can call the DeleteSourceServer operation to delete a migration source

DeleteWorkgroup.description_en: You can delete a workgroup that you no longer need
DeleteWorkgroup.description_zh: 如果您后期不再需要工作组，可以删除工作组

DescribeReplicationJobs.description_en: Retrieves details about one or more migration tasks
DescribeReplicationJobs.description_zh: 调用DescribeReplicationJobs查询一个或多个迁移任务的详细信息

DescribeSourceServers.description_en: Call the DescribeSourceServers operation to query information about one or more migration sources
DescribeSourceServers.description_zh: 调用DescribeSourceServers查询一个或多个迁移源信息

DescribeWorkgroups.description_en: After a workgroup is created, you can view its information, such as the workgroup name, description, and alert information
DescribeWorkgroups.description_zh: 创建工作组后，您可以查看工作组的相关信息，包括工作组名称、工作组描述、告警信息等

DisableAccessToken.description_en: You can call the DisableAccessToken operation to disable an activation code

DisassociateSourceServers.description_en: Disassociate a migration source from a group if you no longer need to use the group for batch migration or want to delete the group
DisassociateSourceServers.description_zh: 如果某个迁移源后期无需通过工作组批量迁移或者需要删除工作组，则可以取消关联工作组

ListAccessTokens.description_en: Call the ListAccessTokens operation to query for created activation codes and their statuses
ListAccessTokens.description_zh: 调用ListAccessTokens查询已创建的激活码以及激活码的使用情况

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags attached to one or more SMC resources, such as migration sources and migration tasks
ListTagResources.description_zh: 调用ListTagResources查询一个或多个SMC资源（迁移源和迁移任务）已经绑定的标签列表

ModifyReplicationJobAttribute.description_en: You can call the ModifyReplicationJobAttribute operation to modify the information of a migration task
ModifyReplicationJobAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyReplicationJobAttribute修改迁移任务信息

ModifySourceServerAttribute.description_en: The ModifySourceServerAttribute operation modifies the name and description of a migration source
ModifySourceServerAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifySourceServerAttribute修改一个迁移源的名称和描述

ModifyWorkgroupAttribute.description_en: Modifies a workgroup's name and description
ModifyWorkgroupAttribute.description_zh: 创建工作组后，您可以修改工作组的名称和描述信息

StartReplicationJob.description_en: You can call the StartReplicationJob operation to start a migration task
StartReplicationJob.description_zh: 调用StartReplicationJob启动一个迁移任务

StopReplicationJob.description_en: You can call the StopReplicationJob operation to stop a migration task
StopReplicationJob.description_zh: 调用StopReplicationJob停止一个迁移任务

TagResources.description_en: You can call TagResources to create and attach tags to multiple SMC resources, such as migration sources and migration tasks
TagResources.description_zh: 调用TagResources为指定的SMC资源（迁移源和迁移任务）列表统一创建并绑定标签

UntagResources.description_en: Detaches and deletes tags from specified SMC resources, such as migration sources and migration tasks
UntagResources.description_zh: 为指定的SMC资源（迁移源和迁移任务）统一解绑并删除标签
